'''Collo''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served in the military during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Collo appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he gave Republic players the bonus series for Alderaan. He, along with his Imperial counterpart Mistress [[Amaran (Rattataki)|Amaran]] and the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] bonus series mission givers, were removed in Game Update 4.1.<ref name="Patch notes 4.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/282016/game-update-4.1-anarchy-paradise-patch-notes|text=Game Update 4.1: Anarchy in Paradise Patch Notes}}</ref>
